messages.author: Priyasha Majee
messages.body:
Dear All,
I am doing DCCM analysis. I am trying to plot the output on gnuplot. I
used the following output file, matrix.gnu :
1.000    1.000  1.000
1.000    2.000  0.862
1.000    3.000  0.721
1.000    4.000  0.663
1.000    5.000  0.739
1.000    6.000  0.671
1.000    7.000  0.361
1.000    8.000  0.365
1.000    9.000  0.287
1.000   10.000 -0.053
1.000   11.000 -0.140
1.000   12.000 -0.105
1.000   13.000 -0.261
1.000   14.000 -0.431
1.000   15.000 -0.424
1.000   16.000 -0.376
1.000   17.000 -0.465
.......
i used the code:
set view 0,0,1,1
set pm3d map
set cbrange [-1:1]
set palette defined (0 0 0 0, 1 0 0 1, 3 0 1 0, 4 1 0 0, 6 1 1 1)
splot "matrix.gnu" matrix
i am getting a blank plot. Can someone help me with gnuplot code to plot
DCCM matrix map?
Thanks in Advance
-Priyasha

messages.author: Hector A. Baldoni
messages.body:
Hi Priyasha,
Hello, I hope the following script can serve as a starting point for
you:
#=======
set terminal pngcairo enhanced font 'Arial,12' size 800,600
set output 'dccm_map.png'
set view map
set pm3d map
set cbrange [-1:1]
set palette defined (-1 'blue', 0 'white', 1 'red')
set xlabel 'Eje X' font 'Arial,12,bold'
set ylabel 'Eje Y' font 'Arial,12, bold'
set title 'Mapa de la matriz DCCM' font 'Arial,14,bold'
splot "matrix.gnu" matrix with image
#=========
Regards,
Hector.
